title.narrative: Climate Finance Access, Absorption and Implementation in the Pacific

description.narrative: The UK SIDAR program has funding for climate finance access support in the Pacific. This will be used to embedded climate finance advisors with a variety of skills sets depending on country needs, in Ministries of Finance, national development banks or other relevant entities. Initially four countries will be targeted (Samoa, Solomon Islands, Tonga and Vanuatu) for a two year period, with potential extension. A further two countries (Fiji, PNG) may also be added in the second year. The UK funding will also support two scoping studies for further support in Year 2 of the program.
